browser: Chrome for Testing via Playwright, headless, fresh profile, real unpacked extension, no optional grants

checks.name: A link to a PDF shows the citation it borrows from the saved page that names it as its PDF, and says so
Move to…: the panel says what happens; everything travels, a repeat stays, a column is matched and one created, the borrowed citation goes too; Undo puts both collections back exactly
Copy to… a new collection: a name is required; copies get new ids and columns, the source and the open collection stay; Undo removes the new collection
Move to… in a link’s details moves that link; Escape closes the panel and returns focus
At 320 px nothing overflows with the panel open
Text contrast is at least 4.5:1 in light and dark for the buttons and the panel
